message: Found usage of eval()/exec()/system() in main.ts. Note: Flagged as High Severity injection vulnerability.
Source files are placed in root.
Project lacks a dedicated tests directory.
Project has neither requirements.txt nor package.json.
Project lacks an example environment variables file.
`eval()` executes a string as JavaScript code. Attacker-controlled input leads to code injection (CWE-95). Use JSON.parse() for data, or restructure to avoid dynamic evaluation.
